explication: Beachpatrol is a browser-automation CLI hub: users launch a persistent Chromium or Firefox instance, then invoke Playwright command scripts through beachmsg and receive streamed output. Commands can use the active tab or other tabs in the browser context; built-in commands include tab listing and a smoke test. The active-page extension signals tab changes into Playwright, and browser downloads are saved to the user’s download directory. The README documents a browser-extension UI and Native Messaging integration, but that UI and messaging host are not present in this repository tree. Some server details are only partially excerpted, so the graph limits links to visible code or documented behavior.
